# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

We want a welcoming, constructive community. Participate with respect, assume good intent, and focus criticism on the work rather than the person. Harassment, discrimination, threats, doxxing, sexualized conduct, and sustained disruption are not acceptable.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate and patient in issues, reviews, and chat.
- Provide reproducible technical details without sharing credentials, forwarding secrets, or private player data.
- Accept differing viewpoints and actionable review feedback.
- Respect project boundaries and approval gates, including the default no-NMS/no-ProtocolLib/no-direct-packet policy.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Personal attacks, insults, harassment, or discriminatory language.
- Publishing private information or secrets without consent.
- Deliberate disruption of servers, Redis instances, development networks, or other people's work.
- Misrepresenting blocked runtime evidence as a successful result.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior privately to the repository maintainers through the project's configured contact channel. Include links or a factual description, and avoid reposting sensitive content publicly. Maintainers may remove content, close discussions, or restrict participation when necessary to protect the community. They will handle reports discreetly and fairly.
